channel.title: Maba Agro Journal
channel.description: Field notes on growing, selling and cooking mushrooms.

item.title: Button mushroom farming in North India: a season-by-season guide
item.description: How button mushrooms are grown across Uttar Pradesh, Haryana and Punjab, from seasonal sheds to climate-controlled rooms, and what each stage needs.

item.title: What is mushroom compost? Inside Phase I and Phase II
item.description: Button mushrooms grow on a specially prepared compost. Here is what goes into it, how Phase I and Phase II work, and why rushing it ruins a crop.

item.title: Mushroom spawn explained: how a mushroom's "seed" is made
item.description: Mushrooms don't grow from seeds. They grow from spawn. Here is what spawn is, how it is produced, and how growers choose and handle it.

item.title: The casing layer: the step most new mushroom growers get wrong
item.description: Casing turns a colonised compost bed into a mushroom crop. What casing is, what it is made of, and how to apply and manage it well.

item.title: Temperature, humidity and fresh air: running a mushroom growing room
item.description: The three dials every mushroom grower manages every day, why carbon dioxide matters as much as heat, and the signs a growing room is out of balance.

item.title: Oyster (dhingri) mushroom cultivation on wheat straw
item.description: Why oyster mushrooms suit Indian conditions, how they are grown on pasteurised straw, and what makes them a good first crop for new growers.

item.title: Growing shiitake on sawdust blocks: patience pays
item.description: Shiitake is slower and more demanding than button or oyster mushrooms. How it is grown on supplemented sawdust, the browning stage, and why chefs value it.

item.title: What "organically grown" actually means on our farm
item.description: Organic is a word that gets used loosely. Here is exactly what it means in our growing rooms, from substrate and pest control to what happens after harvest.

item.title: Common mushroom diseases and pests, and how clean farms prevent them
item.description: Wet bubble, dry bubble, green mould, cobweb, flies and mites. What they look like, how they spread, and why hygiene beats chemicals.

item.title: Harvesting mushrooms: timing, technique and the veil
item.description: When to pick, how to pick, and why a few hours make the difference between a premium mushroom and a discounted one.

item.title: The mushroom cold chain: from growing room to mandi in hours
item.description: Mushrooms are among the most perishable vegetables sold in India. How pre-cooling, cold storage and fast dispatch keep them white and firm.

item.title: How to store fresh mushrooms at home so they last
item.description: The paper bag trick, why you shouldn't wash mushrooms before storing them, how long each variety keeps, and whether you can freeze them.

item.title: How to clean mushrooms: wash or wipe?
item.description: The old rule says never wash mushrooms. The truth is more practical. How to clean button, oyster, shiitake and portobello the right way.

item.title: Button, oyster, shiitake or portobello? A cook's guide
item.description: How the four most popular mushrooms differ in flavour and texture, and which one to choose for kadhai, curries, stir-fries, broths and the grill.

item.title: Mushroom nutrition: protein, fibre, vitamins and minerals
item.description: What's actually in a mushroom, how it fits into a vegetarian Indian diet, and the claims worth taking with a pinch of salt.

item.title: Vitamin D in mushrooms: the sunlight trick
item.description: Mushrooms can make vitamin D, much like human skin. How it works, why most mushrooms contain very little, and how to boost it at home.

item.title: Mushrooms in the Indian kitchen: from kadhai to biryani
item.description: How mushrooms found their way into North Indian cooking, the classic dishes to know, and the techniques that make them taste their best with Indian spices.

item.title: Buying mushrooms wholesale: a guide for sabzi mandi traders
item.description: What to check when buying mushrooms in bulk, how grading works, how to protect your margins from spoilage, and what to expect from a good supplier.

item.title: What hotel kitchens look for in a mushroom supplier
item.description: Consistency, food safety, specs and reliability. What executive chefs and purchase teams expect from a fresh mushroom supplier, and how to meet it.

item.title: Why mushroom prices in India move through the year
item.description: The seasons, weddings, festivals and weather that drive mushroom prices up and down in North Indian markets, and how buyers can plan around them.

item.title: Starting a mushroom farm in Uttar Pradesh: training, support and first steps
item.description: A practical starting point for farmers and entrepreneurs: where to train, which crop to start with, and where to ask about government support.

item.title: Spent mushroom substrate: from farm waste to soil gold
item.description: What happens to compost and straw after the last harvest, and why spent mushroom substrate is valuable for fields, gardens and the circular farm.

item.title: Preserving mushrooms: drying, pickling and powders
item.description: Bought too many mushrooms? How to dry them, make an Indian-style mushroom pickle, and turn dried mushrooms into a flavour-packed powder.

item.title: Six common myths about mushrooms, busted
item.description: Are mushrooms vegetarian? Do they grow on dirt? Should they never be washed? Clearing up the things people often get wrong about mushrooms.

item.title: How to pick good mushrooms at the market
item.description: A quick shopper's checklist for choosing fresh button, oyster, shiitake and portobello mushrooms, plus the warning signs to walk away from.
